world_news.headline: Todd Russell, Beaconsfield mine collapse survivor, dies aged 54 due to illness
world_news.summary:
Tasmanian premier leads tributes for Russell, who earlier this month returned home to ‘see out his days’

  • Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast

Beaconsfield mine collapse survivor Todd Russell has died aged 54 after recently announcing deteriorating health.

The Tasmanian premier, Jeremy Rockliff, led the tributes on Tuesday morning, saying his thoughts were with Russell’s loved ones.

world_news.headline: Teenager who planned terror attack in Sydney tells court he was radicalised online and used AI to strategise
world_news.summary:
Boy says he was first exposed to extremist material on TikTok, turned to Telegram and YouTube for bomb-making instructions, and used ChatGPT to devise his plans

  • Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast

A teenager who admitted to planning a terrorist attack in Sydney in 2024 has told the court he was radicalised online after first seeing extremist material on TikTok and used ChatGPT to form his plans.

The 16-year-old, known under the pseudonym as RK due to his age, pleaded guilty to acts in preparation for, or planning, a terrorist act. In a sentencing ruling on Monday, he avoided jail time, with the New South Wales supreme court ordering him into a three-year community corrections order.
